scope: Issue #277's source-locked, workspace-specific Core REST inventory. Twenty generates REST and GraphQL schemas per workspace; no GraphQL or metadata operation is inferred from the REST contract.

source_lock.rule: Each of the 168 source-locked api_surface endpoints has exactly one covered_by projection; the listed artifacts are the non-duplicated operation manifest.

binary_read.evidence: The source-locked REST inventory has only JSON resource endpoints. Attachment resource CRUD is not an inferred binary transfer operation.

binary_write.evidence: The source-locked REST inventory has no upload or other binary transfer endpoint; no REST write is recast as binary.

direct_read.evidence: One operation-backed get command per Twenty object with exact REST path and json_redacted output policy.

direct_write.evidence: The source-locked REST mutations are schema-backed typed reverse-ETL actions, not direct-write operation contracts. GraphQL mutations are separately schema-generated per workspace and are not inferred.

reverse_etl.safety: Every action uses plan, preview, approval, and execute; all 28 delete actions retain typed destructive confirmation.

action_eligibility.rule: Every action remains implemented and CLI-reachable. Safety, privilege, and destructive classification govern execution and cannot be an ineligibility reason.

typed_destination.boundary: The adapter cannot transport tombstones and cannot form a required batch records array from one source record. Those transport semantic limits do not remove, disable, or reclassify any typed delete or batch CLI command.
typed_destination.application_dispatch: #4304 head d814875a902be684cb2a38b94f7a8077f66b70b1 is merged locally and persists a selected action, but its source-binding lookup is one mapping per executor/stream and cannot preserve each selected Twenty action's exact input fields.
typed_destination.multiplicity_dependency: write_eligibility.json records 55 record-shaped actions that need provider-neutral per-action source bindings. Final acceptance requires 56 record-shaped bindings with exact provider-sourced input fields; no connector workaround is present.

executable_cli.evidence: TestAllProviderOperationsHaveExecutableCommands runs the actual commandrunner preflight for every command; connectorgen surface-sync verifies endpoint ownership.

reconciliation.verification_contract: connector-local red/green persisted per-action destination and all-action eligibility tests; the current refreshed #4304 source-binding limitation must first close without a connector workaround; then connectorgen validation and surface sync, ancestor proof plus installed App/CLI dispatch, certification checks, connector boundary, and fresh credentialed built-binary pagination, CRUD cleanup, ETL, reverse-ETL acknowledgement/read-back, and documented-binary proof against the dedicated instance.
